title: Xbox rescues Hideo Kojima's Physint after PlayStation cancellation
summary: Sony cancels Kojima Productions' action and espionage project and Microsoft takes over publishing to ensure its release on PC and consoles.

title: September 2026 Nintendo Direct reveals Metroid Ravenous, open-world Kirby, and Persona 6 for Switch 2
summary: The presentation confirms an avalanche of exclusive and multiplatform titles for the console, including new 2D Metroid, 3D Kirby, and the arrival of Persona 4 Revival and Persona 6.

title: Metroid Ravenous announced for Switch 2 with January 2027 release and Samus speaking again
summary: The new Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive 2D Metroid shows improved graphics, 120Hz support, and a Samus with dialogue, breaking series tradition.

title: Blizzard workers ratify historic union contract with Microsoft with AI and layoff protections
summary: Nearly 1,900 employees approve the first collective bargaining agreement giving them a voice in generative AI use and guarantees against workforce reductions.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation shapes up as massive, ambitious finale, 500,000 times larger than Rebirth
summary: Director Naoki Hamaguchi promises an uncompromising conclusion with enormous content, while impressions warn of potential bloat.

title: Kirby and the World Beyond takes the pink puffball to a Zelda-style open world on Switch 2 for spring 2027
summary: The first open-world 3D Kirby is shown in the Nintendo Direct with free exploration, evolved copy abilities, and vibrant aesthetic.

title: PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium add WWE 2K26 and more games in September 2026
summary: The monthly catalog includes the new wrestling game, classic titles, and several surprises for higher-tier subscribers.

title: No Man's Sky celebrates 10th anniversary with Cosmos update: own space stations and orbital bases
summary: Hello Games lets players buy and manage space stations, build floating bases, and enjoy solar vacations in the largest free update to date.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in December with local and cross-platform play
summary: Capcom confirms the monster hunter port for Nintendo's new console with local co-op and cross-play, plus the Ascendance expansion.

title: Mario Kart World receives free update with 10 classic SNES tracks and 120Hz mode
summary: Version 1.8.0 adds retro tracks, performance improvements, and balance adjustments, available now for all Switch 2 players.

title: Nintendo Switch 2 updates to firmware 23.0.0 with VRR support in TV mode and stability improvements
summary: The update adds variable refresh rate on dock, fixes bugs, and arrives 15 months after the feature's initial promise.

title: Valheim 1.0 hits 5-year Steam player record, surpassing early access peak
summary: The official launch of the Viking survival game drives concurrency to 5-year highs, though it doesn't surpass the viral peak of its early access debut.

title: Ikea launches official Skyrim mod with Matt Berry as sentient bookshelf Kallax Storageborn
summary: The Swedish manufacturer releases a free expansion adding a talking bookshelf voiced by the actor, blending advertising and humor in Tamriel.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 includes weapon skin only visible on Xbox consoles
summary: Activision introduces an exclusive camouflage that only renders correctly on Xbox hardware, sparking debate about platform parity.

title: Bloober Team announces Onyx: The Dark Grip, Switch 2-exclusive horror from creators of Silent Hill 2 remake
summary: The Polish studio leverages the new console's hardware for psychological horror that wouldn't be possible on other platforms, according to its developers.

title: Spyro: A Realm Beyond shows new art and confirms multiplatform development
summary: Toys for Bob reveals illustrations of the purple dragon, his allies, and the world of Arcadian Vale, previewing the classic platformer's next adventure.

title: Blood of Dawnwalker: Rebel Wolves seeks writer for sequel while polishing vampire power fantasy
summary: The studio founded by ex-CD Projekt shows progress on its action RPG and already plans a continuation, though navigation and systems remain in adjustment.

title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam sets December 2026 release on Switch
summary: Level-5 announces the date for the new puzzle adventure taking the professor and Luke to a steampunk world with renewed puzzles.

title: Persona 4 Revival confirmed for Switch 2 and Persona 6 hinted for future
summary: Atlus announces the remake of the PS2 classic for Nintendo's new console and hints that the next main entry will also come to the platform.

title: Stellar Blade arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 in November with physical edition and technical improvements
summary: Shift Up ports its hack-and-slash action to the hybrid console with all downloadable content and a carefully crafted collector's edition.

title: Final hearing begins in Rockstar Games lawsuit against former GTA 6 employees for wrongful termination
summary: The court hears final arguments as Rockstar rejects union allegations and defends its decision to fire the developers.

title: Sega acknowledges many of its biggest fans don't play its video games, but consume merch and lore
summary: The Japanese company studies how to monetize an audience hooked on the brand without touching controllers, rethinking its IP strategy.

title: Massive Steam achievements leak exposes spoilers for 70 unannounced games and upcoming releases
summary: A flaw in Valve's API reveals detailed achievements for titles like Hollow Knight: Silksong and other secret projects, forcing developers to react.

title: Switch 2 Mario 40th Anniversary edition sells out in minutes and reappears at speculative prices
summary: Nintendo releases a commemorative limited edition that vanishes from official market instantly, fueling the resale market.
